name: Wait Between Worlds
source:
In this world, the supernatural and the natural worlds co-exist, clash, and everything in-between. Daemons and humans have developed societies, cultures, and professions unique to their world. 

One such figure is the protagonist, a fearless half-demon, half-human professional who specializes in demon hunting. She is well known for her blunt personality and unique set of weapons that can take on anything. When not hunting, engaging in conversations with her clients, or preserving various artifacts, her life is a bit more typical. 

After completing a job, she’ll find herself in need of transportation. In this particular case, she chooses to take the bus, as that is the closest option available. This story will involve her waiting, while also conversing with a strange figure that might have more insights into this world than she has learned. It is a story of a mundane task within a fantastical world.

[from [url=https://reyumah.itch.io/wait-between-worlds]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个世界上，超自然世界与自然世界并存、冲突，以及介于两者之间的一切。恶魔和人类已经发展出了他们世界独有的社会、文化和职业。

主角就是这样的人物之一，他是一位无所畏惧的半恶魔半人类职业者，专门猎杀恶魔。她以直率的性格和可以对抗任何事物的独特武器而闻名。当不打猎、与客户交谈或保存各种文物时，她的生活就更加典型了。

完成工作后，她会发现自己需要交通工具。在这种特殊情况下，她选择乘坐公共汽车，因为这是最近的选择。这个故事将涉及她的等待，同时还会与一个奇怪的人物交谈，这个人物对这个世界的见解可能比她所了解的还要多。这是一个关于奇幻世界中平凡任务的故事。

[来自[url=https://reyumah.itch.io/wait-between-worlds]Itch.io[/url]]
